build: Electronic Arts disk release, two double-sided disks as four G64 side images; play copies made with the game's own Copy utility

extra: tile set 3, unpacked from T35/L12 by enter_map ($2722) with map 1

comments.text: Tile 0 of tile set 3, blank as in every set: the black road surface between the white edge lines (map 1: 21 squares, map 26: 156, most of its T-shaped road). Tile set 3 serves map 1 (its text: 'Leaving Quartz.') and map 26 ('Leaving Needles.', 64 x 64), both on side 2; both draw 35 off their edges.

Tiles 1-6, the figures every set shares (1 grey robot-like humanoid, 2 red and orange one-eyed hulk, 3 yellow and green runner, 4 man in a cyan shirt, 5 tied sack, 6 brown horned creature), none of them in the layers of maps 1 and 26. Computed from the records, map 1's two encounter squares would show 3; map 26 has no encounter squares, and neither map has a loot bag.

Tile 7, the green-shirted party figure that game $AF1D-$AF25 draws on the party's square; maps 1 and 26 place no figure 7 of their own (map 26's class-4 records 3 and 4, $4CD2 and $4CD6, name tile 7 only for the square ahead of the party on a train ride, while tile 7 holds the train's picture). For the ride, map 26's train_swap_tiles ($4EF9) exchanges tile 7's bitmap and colour bytes with 95's (eastward, class-6 record 0) or 93's (westward, class-6 record 2) and swaps them back at the end of the line, so the party is drawn as the train. It is where the self-modified operand of draw_tile's LDA $D0E0,X ($2367) points, because tile 7 was the last tile drawn.
Tile 8, the radiation sign: draw_square shows it from 18:00 to 05:59 on map 26's 54 class-9 squares (scattered over x 5-26, y 5-57), which show their ground tile by day ($0B80-$0B8A); map 1 has none.
Tile 9 of set 3, a purple peak over light blue and blue bars: the picture game $AD13-$AD49 draws for each of the player's other parties on the map in view. Not in the layers of maps 1 and 26.

Tiles 10-15 of set 3: 10 grey and white rubble (37 squares of map 26: 28 at x 36-59, y 13-22, among and beside the walls of 50 there, and 9 at x 10-12, y 54-57, inside the square walled by 50 at x 7-15, y 51-59); 11 grey, white and light blue upright bands (map 26 at (12, 55), class 10); 12 two green cacti on black (map 1: 8, map 26: 12, all class 2) and 13 one cactus (map 1: 8); 14 green stripes and 15 rows of green dots, unused by the maps.

Tiles 16-23 of set 3, white fence pieces on green-speckled ground: corners 16-19, sides 20-22 and 23, a tree under the fence's top edge. They fence map 1's graveyard (x 26-29, y 23-29; the map's texts include 'You are in the graveyard.') and the rubble 10 inside map 26's walled square (x 9-13, y 53-57): 16-19 one square on map 1 and two on map 26 each, 20: 2, 21: 5, 22: 4, 23: 3; all class 2.

Tiles 24-27 of set 3: 24 red dashes on black (446 squares: map 1: 327, 26: 119), 25 green dashes (601: map 1: 10, 26: 591); 26 and 27 black with a small grey and white mark in the top right or bottom left corner, where two white road edges meet at a junction (26: 13 squares of map 1 and one of 26, 27: 10 of map 1).
Tiles 28 and 29 of set 3, purple blocks with black cracks, 28 edged light blue at its left and top: parts of the purple buildings of map 26 (28: 5) and maps 1 and 26 (29: 8 and 3), class 11.

Tiles 30-34 of set 3: 30 light green bushes over green dashes (14 squares of map 1) and 31 four light green bushes (4); 32 white and grey stripes with red and black (map 26 at (50, 15), class 10); 33 and 34 a broad green tree on a brown trunk (map 1: 1 and 4).
Tiles 35 and 36 of set 3, red dashes on black: 35 (map 1: 1, map 26: 719 squares) is also the off-map tile of both maps (record byte $33 = $23); 36 (1694 squares of map 26, its commonest tile).

Tiles 37-43 of set 3: 37-40 blue blocks with black cracks, 37-39 edged light blue (37: 4 squares, 38: 2, 39: 2 of maps 1 and 26; 40 unused) and 41-43 purple ones (map 26: 6, 5 and 5), building pieces, all class 11.
Tiles 44-47 of set 3, white right-angle corners on black, the corners of the roads and of small black areas outlined in white (44: 3, 45: 5, 46: 7, 47: 4 squares of maps 1 and 26).
Tile 48 of set 3, red sleepers between two white rails: the railway across map 26 (61 squares, row 40, mostly class 1); its class-4 squares (11, 40) and (12, 40) show the tank car 94 and 95 on it.

Tiles 49-52 of set 3: 49 two white upright lines on black (map 26 at (43, 32), (45, 32), (43, 33), (45, 33)); 50 grey and white rubble in lines (86 class-11 squares of map 26: walls along y 4, x 37 and x 59 within x 36-60, y 3-20, the square at x 7-15, y 51-59 and three at (46-47, 25-26); the map's texts speak of a broken town wall); 51 white crosses and grey stones on green, map 1's graveyard (10 squares); 52 a grey drum seen from the side, on six squares of map 1's roads (class 8).

Tiles 53-60 of set 3, building edges with a gap: the entrances of the purple (53, 55, 57, 59) and blue (54, 56, 58, 60) buildings, nearly all on class-10 squares, the exits into other maps (53: 6, 54: 10, 55: 7, 56: 3, 57: 12, 58: 9, 60: 2 squares of maps 1 and 26; 59 unused).
Tiles 61-64 of set 3, black with one white edge line, right (61: 107 squares), bottom (62: 155), left (63: 110) and top (64: 145): the edges of the roads of maps 1 and 26.

Tiles 65-76 of set 3, purple blocks edged light blue and white: the corners and sides of the purple buildings of maps 1 and 26, seen from above (65: 19, 66: 22, 67: 21, 68: 25, 69: 11, 70: 11, 71: 8, 72: 20, 73: 3, 74: 13, 76: 20 squares; 75 unused), all class 11.

Tiles 77-88 of set 3, the same pieces in blue for the blue buildings (77: 19, 78: 14, 79: 16, 80: 21, 82: 3, 83: 3, 84: 15, 85: 5, 86: 4, 88: 16 squares of maps 1 and 26; 81 and 87 unused), all class 11; 81, 83 and 84 have black cracks.

Tiles 89-92 of set 3: 89 and 90 red dashes on black (map 26: 57, mostly class 2, most of them in patches around x 30-50, y 45-51; and 167); solid fills 91 purple (31 squares inside map 26's purple buildings) and 92 blue (6 inside its blue ones).

Tiles 93-95 of set 3, a light blue tank car with red and white wheels and rails: 94 and 95 are what map 26's class-4 squares (11, 40) and (12, 40) show on the railway, over the layer's track 48; 93, a third piece, is in no layer but is the tile of map 26's class-4 record 2 ($4CCE), which remote-change record 2 ($4E5A) puts at (50, 40), beside 94 at (51, 40), when the train reaches the east end of the line. For a ride, train_swap_tiles ($4EF9) exchanges 95 (eastward) or 93 (westward) with tile 7, bitmap and colour bytes, so the party is drawn as the train until the other end.

Colour bytes of tiles 0-9 in set 3, one a cell (high nibble: pixel pairs 01, low: pairs 10): tiles 0-8 as in every set ($26, $CF, $28, $57, $39/$36, $B7/$BC, $98, $59, $76) and tile 9's $46, $46, $E6, $E6.

Colour bytes of tiles 10-27 in set 3: $CB for the rubble 10 and $CB/$CE for 11; $57 and $56 (green; the cacti use pixel pairs 00 and 01 only, so the yellow and blue never show) for the cacti 12-13; $56 for 14-15; $55 for the fence pieces 16-22, with $25 in 17's top right cell, and $55 over $59 for the tree 23; $52 in the top left cell and $22 (red) in the others for the ground 24, $55 for 25; $B6 and $BC (dark grey, blue, grey) for the corner marks 26-27.

Colour bytes of tiles 28-43 in set 3: $4E and $46 (purple with light blue or blue) for the cracked purple blocks 28-29 and 41-43; $5D with a $56 cell for the bushes 30-31; $2B and $CB for the stripes 32; $56 over $59 for the trees 33-34; $27 (red, yellow) for the red ground 35-36; $E6 with $26 cells for the blue blocks 37-39; $26 for 40.

Colour bytes of tiles 44-64 in set 3: $26 for the road corners 44-47, the lines 49 and the road edges 61-64; $2B (red, dark grey) for the track 48; $C6 and $CB for the rubble 50; $56 and $5C for the graves 51; $CB for the drum 52; $4E, $46, $2E for the purple entrances and $E6, $26, $46 for the blue ones (53-60).

Colour bytes of tiles 65-88 in set 3: $4E and $46 (purple with light blue or blue) for the purple walls 65-76, with $2E (red, light blue) cells in 65, 69, 70 and 71; $E6 (light blue, blue) and $26 for the blue walls 77-88.
Colour bytes of tiles 89-95 in set 3: $27 for the dashes 89-90; $46 for the solid purple 91 and $26 for the solid blue 92 (pairs 10); $2E (red, light blue) for the tank car 93-95.
